ambiguity.evidence: change.md and frame.md fix the outcome (Claude step usage recorded at step time, router owns identity and evidence check), but research.md lists six open questions (design a/b/c, how agentId reaches the router, session ID at dispatch, finished timing, no-evidence behaviour, hostVersion unknown) that each have more than one reasonable answer.

novelty.evidence: research.md: router already imports the transcript measurer (init-usage.mjs:44) and the Codex runner measures its own dispatch, so the pattern exists; but a host-supplied agentId that the router then anchors on, across async hand-back dispatch, is a new integration next to that pattern.

coupling.evidence: research.md: the change spans flow.mjs attachResult (685-688), route.mjs next and the usage command (840-932), claude-usage.mjs, claude-transcript.mjs, state.mjs, and the shared last-result.json contract consumed by both 10x and openspec chains via both SKILL.md files.

discovery.evidence: goal names claude-usage.mjs and both SKILL.md loops, but research.md finds further areas not named in the goal (init-usage.mjs, late-usage path route.mjs:889-896, usage.mjs unavailableEvidence, pinned phrases in skill-loop.test.mjs:632-681) that need one or more searches to confirm.

volume.evidence: research.md touches more than 10 files: two SKILL.md, flow.mjs, route.mjs, claude-usage.mjs, claude-transcript.mjs, usage.mjs, state.mjs, docs/REFERENCE.md, ADR-018/019 amendments, plus several tests (claude-usage, late-usage, result-persist, skill-loop, openspec-skill).

verification.evidence: existing tests cover collector, late usage and skill phrases (claude-usage.test.mjs:285-296, late-usage.test.mjs:619-829), but checking the async launch, finished timing and resumed-session behaviour needs a new harness part, since research.md marks finished-before-hand-back as unverified.
